fusions.name: Point-Blank Report
fusions.desc: Fires a slug of packed force that deals 32 damage to the first enemy it meets and ignores its armour.

fusions.name: Buckshot Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks 3 pellets of force in a spread; each deals 3 damage.

fusions.name: Snap Reload
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Loaded Chamber
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
